entries.name: Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Raises Magic damage by 20% in PvE and 12.5% in PvP
entries.ceiling: Best long-duration damage tear for any magic package
entries.limitation: Only affects the magic portion of split damage

entries.name: Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Raises Fire damage by 20% in PvE and 12.5% in PvP
entries.ceiling: Full-fight boost to Fire Knight's Greatsword, Blasphemous Blade, Anvil Hammer, and fire incantations
entries.limitation: Only affects the fire portion of split damage

entries.name: Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Raises Lightning damage by 20% in PvE and 12.5% in PvP
entries.ceiling: Full-fight boost to Dragon Cult incantations
entries.limitation: Only affects lightning damage

entries.name: Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Raises Holy damage by 20% in PvE and 12.5% in PvP
entries.ceiling: Full-fight boost to Ordovis, Siluria, Euporia, Marika's Hammer, and holy effects
entries.limitation: Only affects the holy portion and is poor against holy-resistant bosses

entries.name: Deflecting Hardtear
entries.effect: Enables enhanced spontaneous guards and escalating post-deflect damage, stamina, and stance bonuses
entries.ceiling: Transforms shields and weapon guards into a full offensive-defense system for five minutes
entries.limitation: Requires precise timing and player execution

entries.name: Thorny Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Successive hits raise attack power by 9% / 13% / 20%
entries.ceiling: Reaches a large universal damage bonus on rapid attacks and multi-hit skills
entries.limitation: Requires hit continuity and is weak on slow single-hit play

entries.name: Spiked Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Raises charged heavy attack damage by 15%
entries.ceiling: Stacks naturally with Axe Talisman and stance-focused heavy weapons
entries.limitation: Does not boost ordinary attacks or most weapon skills

entries.name: Opaline Hardtear
entries.effect: Raises all damage negation by 15% in PvE and 10% in PvP
entries.ceiling: Full-fight mitigation against every damage type
entries.limitation: No direct offensive increase

entries.name: Bloodsucking Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Raises all damage by 20%; drains (0.2% max HP + 20) HP each second
entries.ceiling: Boosts physical and elemental damage simultaneously
entries.limitation: Severe continuous HP drain; requires healing, speed, or encounter knowledge

entries.name: Strength-knot Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Raises Strength by 10
entries.ceiling: Very strong before hard caps or for one-handed shield packages
entries.limitation: Marginal at 80 Strength and reduced value when two-handing from 54 Strength

entries.name: Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Raises Dexterity by 10
entries.ceiling: Can unlock a weapon or improve a Dexterity package
entries.limitation: AHW already meets its chosen 18 DEX requirements and does not scale primarily with DEX

entries.name: Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Raises Intelligence by 10
entries.ceiling: Can temporarily unlock equipment or spells
entries.limitation: AHW has no stable Intelligence casting package and loses access when the buff expires

entries.name: Faith-knot Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Raises Faith by 10
entries.ceiling: At L150 raises 31 FAI to 41, enabling Knight's Lightning Spear and Blessing of the Erdtree
entries.limitation: Temporary requirement access ends when the tear expires; does not reach 42/46 FAI spells at L150

entries.name: Greenburst Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Raises stamina regeneration by 15 per second
entries.ceiling: Sustains attacks, rolls, sprinting, blocking, and guard counters
entries.limitation: Consumes a slot without directly raising damage or defense

entries.name: Stonebarb Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Raises poise, stance, and stamina damage by 30%
entries.ceiling: Massive opening value for charged heavies, Lion's Claw, Crucible skills, and guard counters
entries.limitation: Only 30 seconds; poor if drunk too early or the boss disengages

entries.name: Windy Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Adds 3 roll invincibility frames and lowers all damage negation by 15%
entries.ceiling: Improves medium-roll timing for an entire fight
entries.limitation: Substantial damage-taken penalty and no stack with Crucible Feather effects

entries.name: Glovewort Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Raises Spirit Ash damage by 7.5%
entries.ceiling: Always active during a normal summon-assisted boss attempt
entries.limitation: No direct player benefit and modest magnitude

entries.name: Winged Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Raises maximum equip load by 450%
entries.ceiling: Allows extremely heavy armor and weapon combinations
entries.limitation: Expiration can force Heavy Load or Overloaded mid-fight

entries.name: Crimson Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Restores 50% of maximum HP immediately
entries.ceiling: Can be paired with another tear and used as an extra heal
entries.limitation: No lasting combat benefit after drinking

entries.name: Greenspill Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Raises maximum stamina by 15%
entries.ceiling: Useful for long attack, sprint, guard, or dodge sequences
entries.limitation: Recovery speed is usually more valuable than a larger pool

entries.name: Crimsonburst Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Restores 7 HP per second, 1,260 HP total
entries.ceiling: Efficient passive recovery over a full dungeon segment
entries.limitation: Too slow for burst survival and weaker than AHW incantation regeneration

entries.name: Cerulean Hidden Tear
entries.effect: Eliminates FP consumption
entries.ceiling: Supports repeated expensive casts or weapon skills
entries.limitation: Short duration and no benefit after the burst window

entries.name: Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear
entries.effect: Non-physical hits restore 5% maximum HP instead of dealing their elemental portion
entries.ceiling: Can trivialize a known elemental barrage
entries.limitation: Extremely short and does not negate physical portions of mixed attacks

entries.name: Oil-Soaked Tear
entries.effect: Continuously oils the user and enemies within 1 meter; the next fire hit receives -20% fire negation
entries.ceiling: Strong on one large, immediate fire hit
entries.limitation: Very short range, affects the user, and is consumed by the next fire hit

entries.name: Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Restores 5 FP per hit
entries.ceiling: Rapid-hit skills can refund meaningful FP
entries.limitation: Requires repeated hits and sacrifices a stronger offensive tear

entries.name: Opaline Bubbletear
entries.effect: Reduces the next incoming hit by 90%
entries.ceiling: Strong against a scripted opener or single lethal attack
entries.limitation: Consumed by any hit, including a weak one; inferior to sustained mitigation for general play

entries.name: Crimson Bubbletear
entries.effect: Automatically restores 30% maximum HP once below roughly 21% HP
entries.ceiling: Can prevent a death during aggressive play or Bloodsucking use
entries.limitation: One-time effect with uncertain timing and no proactive value

entries.name: Purifying Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Greatly reduces Mohg's Bloodboon Ritual damage
entries.ceiling: One of the strongest single-encounter counters in the game
entries.limitation: No use outside Mohg, Lord of Blood

entries.name: Twiggy Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Prevents rune loss on death except Death Blight
entries.ceiling: Removes the risk from a corpse run or planned death
entries.limitation: No combat power

entries.name: Crimsonburst Dried Tear
entries.effect: Restores 7 HP/s to allies within 7 meters; no self-healing
entries.ceiling: Long-duration passive ally sustain
entries.limitation: No benefit to the imbiber and weak healing rate

entries.name: Speckled Hardtear
entries.effect: Clears status buildup/ailments and adds 90 to all status resistances
entries.ceiling: Excellent preemptive answer to a status-heavy encounter
entries.limitation: No direct damage or general damage-negation benefit

entries.name: Leaden Hardtear
entries.effect: Prevents stagger from non-knockdown and non-launching attacks
entries.ceiling: Can force through a short charged skill or spell
entries.limitation: Does not prevent damage and fails against launches/knockdowns

entries.name: Viridian Hidden Tear
entries.effect: Eliminates stamina consumption
entries.ceiling: Can enable uninterrupted attack, sprint, dodge, or guard sequences
entries.limitation: Very short window and competes with three-minute effects

entries.name: Ruptured Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Explodes after drinking; one tear deals 800 Holy attack power and 300 self-damage
entries.ceiling: Two copies create a much larger explosion
entries.limitation: Self-damage, delay, narrow control, and poor normal PvE reliability

entries.name: Crimsonspill Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Raises maximum HP by 10%; added HP is not filled
entries.ceiling: Can stack with HP-boosting Great Runes and talismans
entries.limitation: Provides no immediate healing and is weaker than direct mitigation at 60 Vigor

entries.name: Cerulean Crystal Tear
entries.effect: Restores 50% of maximum FP immediately
entries.ceiling: Two copies can restore 100% FP
entries.limitation: A Cerulean flask normally solves the same problem without consuming a Physick slot

entries.name: Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear
entries.effect: Restores 0.8% of maximum HP per hit
entries.ceiling: Can offset attrition on very rapid attacks
entries.limitation: Low return per hit and short window; costs a damage/defense slot
